result.headline: Throttle command dropped to zero at about 116 s with no recorded event, followed by loss of altitude and worse pitch tracking.
result.explanation: Throttle (loop on ch[2]) went to 0 around 116 s with no mode change or event, and ch[2] followed to 1100 us. Pitch tracking, airspeed and altitude degraded afterwards. Who or what commanded zero is not in the recording.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT propulsion.throttle was varying, then held 0 from t=116.23 s to the end of the recording (16.102 s, 42 samples)
evidence.shows: Throttle command fell from about 33-35% to 0 and stayed there. The only recorded event is the start-up battery warning.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT actuator.output[ch[2]] was varying, then held 1100 from t=116.827 s to the end of the recording (15.267 s, 47 samples)
evidence.shows: The throttle output channel followed the zero command down to 1100 us and stayed there.

evidence.quote: ROLE actuator.output[ch[2]] follows propulsion.throttle (correlation 0.986 over the recording): it serves that loop
evidence.shows: ch[2] is the throttle/propulsion channel, so the output is consistent with the command.

evidence.quote: SHIFT vehicle.attitude[pitch] followed its setpoint worse for good from t=116.067 s: typical |error| 1.517 before, 7.866 after deg (7.6x its variation before)
evidence.shows: Pitch tracking degraded at the same moment as the throttle loss. This is an effect.

evidence.quote: SHIFT vehicle.altitude[relative] changed level for good at t=120.973 s: median 49.993 before, 39.261 after m (11.9x its variation before)
evidence.shows: Altitude fell from about 50 m to 28 m by the end of the recording, consistent with a descent after power loss.

checked.check: Sequence of signals leaving baseline from 95 to 125 s
checked.result: Roll/yaw manoeuvre signals moved from 103 s on. Throttle and ch[2] show the permanent change at 116 s.

checked.check: Compare before and after 116.2 s (10 s window)
checked.result: Throttle went from 35 to 0 and is flagged frozen. ch[2] went from 1380 to 1100 us. Pitch tracking error ratio is 3.5x. Altitude and airspeed fall.
The changes are yaw and velocity manoeuvres with tracking held or improved. Throttle at 99.658 s is not a real change: it reads 33-41% until about 115 s.
ch[1] keeps moving with the pitch setpoint, then steps to 1351 us at 121.391 s as the setpoint rises. It follows the controller and is not stuck.

hypotheses.claim: Autopilot, failsafe or operator commanded throttle to 0 around 116 s.
hypotheses.because: Throttle held 0 with no recorded mode event, and ch[2] followed the command.
hypotheses.observed_at: controller throttle command and ch[2] output

hypotheses.claim: Motor or ESC fault removed thrust and the controller zeroed throttle in response.
hypotheses.because: The motor is not observed. The ch[2] output matches the command and cannot clear the hardware beyond it.

hypotheses.claim: Low pack voltage triggered a cut-off.
hypotheses.because: Low-voltage warning at 1.339 s is start-up only. No voltage series exists to link it to 116 s.

hypotheses.claim: A pitch-loop actuator fault caused the tracking degradation.
